Ek line 0 se 2 tak hai. 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain, aur 1 aur 2 ke beech bhi 6, sab barabar doori par. 0 se 9 gap chalo toh kis fraction par pahunchoge?

Sahi jawab. Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki 0 aur 1 ke beech ke har fraction ki line par ek pakki jagah hoti hai, aur uska naam marks se nahi, barabar gaps ginkar milta hai. Phir fraction ka upar wala number aaya, jo batata hai ki 0 se kitne gap chalna hai, aur dono number milkar line ki ek hi jagah ka naam hote hain. Aakhir mein line 1 ke aage chali, aur jab upar wala number neeche wale se bada ho, toh fraction 1 ke aage aata hai. Bachche ne 7/4 ko 1 aur 2 ke beech aur 5/3 ko 1 ke baad pehchana. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
